newsitem.title: ALBANIA: Europe and CIS port conditions - Lloyds.
newsitem.headline: Europe and CIS port conditions - Lloyds.

text.p: Port conditions from Lloyds Shipping Intelligence Service --
ALBANIA, Nov 5 - Durres - Five vessels in port operating, all discharging, of which 1 bulk fish meal, 1 sugar, 3 wheat flour. 1 Vessel waiting in roads to discharge bagged cement.

BULGARIA - Oct 28-Nov 3 - 37 vessels in port operating of which 22 loading (4 general cargo, 2 copper, 5 ammonium nitrate, 1 timber, 1 empty vessel, 1 pipes, 2 steel, 1 iron, 2 benzene, 1 gasoil, 1 chemicals, 1 saoline. 12 discharging (2 sugar, 1 fish meal, 2 cars, 1 containers/ammonium sulphate, 2 coal, 1 ethanol, 1 zinc concentrates, 1 copper concentrates, 1 petrol). 2 Discharging/loading (1 sugar/steel plates, 1 containers/general cargo). 1 Under arrest, 7 waiting in roads of which 3 to load (2 steel, 1 metals). 2 To discharge (1 containers, 1 cars). 1 Awaiting orders, 1 cargo not nominated. 27 vessels due of which 14 to load (4 steel, 1 benzene, 1 copper concentrate, 2 metal, 2 clinker, 1 sugar, 1 ammonium nitrate, 1 tobacco, 1 fodder). 11 To discharge (1 cars, 2 wheat, 1 copper/lead concentrate, 4 iron ore, 2 coal. 2 To discharge/load (1 general cargo/ammonium nitrate, 1 containers/ammonium sulphate.

Varna - Varna east, Varna west, Balchik, Teps - 24 Vessels operating of which 12 loading (1 sulphuric acid, 3 soda, 1 cement, 1 sas, 1 clinker, 1 urea, 1 edc, 1 quartz sand, 1 dcp, 1 ntp). 5 discharging (4 coal, 1 phosphorite). 6 discharging/loading containers, 1 discharging/loading trucks/containers. 6 waiting in roads of which 1 to load kaolin, to discharge phosphate, 1 to discharge/load containers, 1 cargo not nominated. November 4 - Varna - No labour problems. Varna east - 3 Vessels loading at berth, 2 discharging at berth, 1 waiting at anchorage to discharge, 2 awaiting orders. Varna west - 6 loading at berth, 3 discharging at berth, 2 waiting at anchorage to discharge. Varna lesport/tanker port - No vessels. Bourgas - No labour problems. Bourgas east - 5 vessels loading at berth, 6 discharging, 4 waiting at anchorage to load, 2 waiting to discharge. 9 under repairs/dry-docked. 27 vessels due. Bourgas west - 2 loading at berth, 2 discharging. Tanker port - 1 loading at berth, 1 discharging at berth.

CROATIA, Nov 4 - Rijeka - Four vessels discharging at berth, 2 loading. 6 Vessels under repair/dry-docked, 2 vessels at inoperative berth, 2 anchored. 7 due, delays expected. Zadar - one discharging at berth, 2 due, delays expected. Sibenik - One loading at berth. Split - One discharging at berth, 1 under repair/dry-docked. Ploce - Five vessels discharging at berth, 1 loading/discharging. Pula, Rasa, Dubrovnik - No vessels.

CYPRUS, Nov 5 - Limassol - Three container vessels discharging/loading at berth, 3 conventional files discharging. 1 waiting at anchor to discharge/load, 12 due 5-6/11 of which 5 containers, 2 conventional vessels, 4 passenger, 1 cruise vessel. Larnaca - One container vessel discharging/loading at berth, 1 conventional vessel discharging. 3 due 5-6/11 of which 1 container vessel, 2 conventional.

ESTONIA, Nov 5 - No labour problems at any port. Tallinn City port - 2 Vessels loading at berth (1 steel billets, 1 map), 1 liner, 5 due. Kopli - 1 Poultry vessel loading at berth, 1 vessel due. Muuga - 4 Vessels loading at berth (2 oil, 1 timber, 1 cellulose), 2 discharging at berth (1 grain, 1 poultry), 2 ferries. 2 Vessels due. Parnu - Two vessels discharging at berth (1 peat, 1 glue). 5 Vessels due.

ITALY, Nov 5 - Naples - Two gas tankers (one etb 6/11, the other over the next few days), 1 container vessel (etb 7/11), 1 bulk carrier (etb 6/11). Gaeta - One bulk carrier etb 7/11. Salerno - No vessels in roads. Genoa commercial port - No vessels in roads, no delays, 44 berthed, 6 dry-docked. Multedo oil harbour - No vessels in roads, no delays, 3 berthed. Savona - No vessels in roads, no delays, 1 berthed. Vado Ligure - No vessels in roads, no delays, 1 berthed. La Spezia - No vessels in roads, no delays, 6 berthed, 5 under repair. Leghorn - Nine vessels in roads, 44 berthed. Civitavecchia, Gaeta, Naples, Salerno, Palermo - No vessels in roads, no delays. Augusta oil harbour - No vessels in roads, no delays, none berthed. Syracuse oil harbour - 1 Vessel in roads, 1 berthed. Sarroch - No information. Taranto - Five vessels in roads totalling 464,260 dwt. Ravenna - 16 In roads. Congestion due to fog. Ancona/Falconara - One in roads, no delays. Venice - 15 Vessels in roads. Trieste - Two in roads.

LATVIA, Nov 5 - No strikes at any port. Riga - 13 Vessels in port, all operating, of which 4 timber loaders, 1 container loader, 1 cotton loader, 2 steel loaders, 2 tanker loaders, 1 scrap metal loader, 1 wheat discharger, 1 potato discharger. No vessels waiting, no delays, 22 vessels due. Ventspils - Two vessels in port of which 1 loading steel billets, 1 waiting. No delays, 17 Vessels due. Liepaja - Four vessels in port, all operating. No vessels waiting, no delays, 1 vessel due.

LITHUANIA, Nov 5 - Klaipeda - 17 Vessels loading of which 2 oil, 3 fertiliser, 2 scrap, 4 steel coils, 1 metal, 1 cement, 2 timber products, 1 cake, 1 preparations. 2 Vessels discharging of which 1 fish, 1 general cargo. 4 Vessels in roads, 31 due.

POLAND, Nov 5 - Szczecin - Forty-one vessels loading at berth, 35 discharging at berth. 1 Vessel waiting at anchorage to load, 14 under repair/dry-docked. 1 Vessel awaiting orders, 81 due. Gdynia - Sixteen vessels operating of which 9 loading at berth (2 coal, 1 grain, 6 general cargo). 7 Discharging at berth (4 grain, 2 bulk, 1 general cargo), 5 under repair/dry-docked, 28 due. Gdansk - Eight vessels operating of which 6 loading at berth (1 coal, 3 general cargo, 2 bulkers). 2 Discharging at berth (1 tanker, 1 general cargo). 4 Vessels under repair/dry-docked, 23 due.
PORTUGAL, Nov 5 - Setubal - Five vessels loading at berth, 4 discharging at berth. 7 Vessels under repair/dry-docked, 3 due of which 5 to discharge, 6 to load, 2 for repairs/dry-dock.

ROMANIA, Nov 5 - Constanta - 37 Vessels operating of which 12 generals (9 loading/3 discharging), 13 bulkers (4 loading/9 discharging), 6 bagged chemicals loading, 3 tankers (1 loading/2 discharging), 1 bagged cement loading, 2 containers discharging. 11 Vessels waiting in roads of which 3 generals, 7 bulkers, 1 container discharger. Constanta south (Agigea) - Three vessels loading. Mangalia - No vessels in port. Midia - Four livestock carriers loading.

RUSSIA - Baltic ports, Nov 5 - St. Petersburg - 22 Vessels operating of which 15 loading (7 non-ferrous metal, 1 saltpetre, 1 containers, 5 fertiliser, 1 cast iron). 7 discharging (1 cars, 3 frozen meat, 1 containers, 1 pipes, 1 machinery). 8 Vessels waiting, 7 due. No strikes. Kaliningrad - Eleven vessels in port of which 10 operating (1 fertiliser loader, 1 coal loader, 1 scrap metal loader, 1 timber loader, 1 aluminium loader, 2 sun flower seed loaders, grain dischargers). 1 Vessel waiting, no delays, 1 vessel due. Vyborg - Five vessels in port, all operating, no vessels waiting, no delays, 2 vessels due.

Far Eastern ports, Nov 5 - No delays/strikes/congestion. Vladivostok - 16 Vessels in port of which 6 loading (3 metal, 1 timber, 2 general cargo), 2 loading/discharging containers, 1 discharging coke, 1 passenger vessel, 6 waiting. Nakhodka - 12 In port of which 8 loading (4 metal, 3 timber, 1 general cargo), 4 waiting. Vostochny - 13 In port of which 9 loading (3 coal, 2 timber, 2 metal, 2 containers), 4 waiting. Posyet - One vessel loading metal. Khasan - Three vessels in port of which 2 loading metal, 1 waiting.

Black Sea, Nov 4 - Novorossiysk - 14 Vessels in port operating of which 9 loading (1 coal, 5 steel, 1 copper cathodes, 1 seeds, 1 molasses). 5 Discharging (2 various, 1 rice, 1 bananas, 1 sugar). 16 Vessels waiting in roads of which 9 to load (1 seed, 2 logs, 1 paper/pipes/coils, 2 steel, 1 blooms, 1 copper, 1 saltpetre). 5 To discharge (3 rice, 1 luggage, 1 citrus), 1 to load/discharge cars, 1 cargo not nominated. 17 Vessels due of which 12 to load (1 scrap, 5 steel, 1 slabs, 1 copper cathodes, 1 seeds, 1 urea, 1 vegetable oil, 1 pressed beet root). 3 To discharge (1 castor oil, 2 luggage), 2 to discharge/load (1 containers, 1 cars). Oil terminal, Nov 5 - 3 Vessels loading in port (2 crude oil, 1 diesel), 8 in roads waiting to load (5 crude oil, 1 diesel, 2 fuel oil), 7 due to load crude oil.

Northern Basin, Nov 5 - Murmansk - Three vessels operating of which 2 alumina, 1 cabotage, 1 cabotage discharger waiting. 5 Vessels due during the week of which 3 dischargers (2 cabotage, 1 general cargo), 2 steel loaders.

SLOVENIA, Nov 4 - Koper - Ten vessels berthed of which 5 bulk carriers discharging (coal, slag, chrome, ore, salt, tin), 1 car carrier discharging cars. 2 Livestock vessels loading bulls, 2 vessels loading/discharging (1 container vessel, 1 ferry). 11 Vessels due over the next 2 days of which 1 bulk carrier to load grain, 3 general cargo vessels to load sawn timber, pipes, steel, 1 car carrier to load cars, 2 livestock vessels to load bulls. 1 Tanker to discharge gasoil, 3 container vessels to load/discharge, no delays expected in port.

SPAIN, Nov 4 - Aviles - Ten vessels in port of which 5 discharging (1 tar, 1 iron ore, 1 scrap, 1 wood, 1 zinc concentrates). 5 Loading (2 steel, 1 aminium, 1 zinc, 1 ammonium nitrate). Gijon - Six vessels in port of which 2 discharging (1 coal, 1 gasoil). 4 Loading (2 steel, 1 cement, 1 coke). Stevedores strike which started 28/10 now on stand-by until 10/11. Sagunto - 15 Vessels operating of which 3 ro/ros discharging/loading. 1 Vessel discharging/loading steel, 8 vessels discharging (7 steel, 1 bananas), 3 loading (2 perishable goods, 1 fertiliser). No vessels berthed outside Commercial wharf, no berthing delays. Bilbao - 21 Vessels operating (1 tanker, 20 dry cargo) of which 5 loading. 9 Discharging, 7 loading/discharging, no delays. Nov 5 - Pasajes - Nine vessels in port of which 8 discharging (2 scrap, 1 steel, 1 steel coils, 1 paper, 3 wood-pulp), 1 loading steel, no delays. Cadiz - Eleven vessels operating of which 4 ro/ros, 1 sand, 1 semolina, 1 shipbuilding materials, 4 under repair, no delays.

TURKEY, Nov 4 - Istanbul - Haydarpasa - 11 Vessels operating of which 4 containers, 6 dry cargo, 1 ro/ro. Galata - 8 Car /ro/ro/ passenger vessels operating, port congested. Ambarli - 13 operating, port congested. Mersin - 27 Vessels operating of which 18 loading (3 pulses, 2 flour, 3 citrus, 1 soda, 2 cement, 1 vehicles, 1 livestock, 1 oil, 2 pumice stone, 1 combine harvester). 5 Discharging (1 rice, 1 beer, 2 manure, 1 zinc), 4 loading/discharging (1 livestock, 3 containers), 10 anchored. Nov 5 - Mersin - 26 Vessels operating of which 16 loading (2 flour, 2 soda, 3 citrus, 1 general cargo, 3 legumes, 1 cement, 2 pumice stone, 1 combine harvester, 1 livestock). 2 Discharging (1 rice, 1 empty beer crates). 7 Loading/discharging (1 vehicles, 4 containers, 1 containers/general cargo, 1 general cargo). 7 Vessels awaiting orders. Free zone piers - 1 Vessel discharging zinc. Seka - Two vessels discharging fertiliser.

UKRAINE, Nov 4 - Mariupol - 11 Vessels loading at berth (4 fertiliser, 3 metal products, 2 coal, 1 sulphur, 1 sunflower seed). 3 Discharging (1 alumina, 1 chrome ore, 1 general cargo). 6 Waiting at anchorage to load (1 coal, 1 fertiliser, 3 metal products, 1 mustard seed). 9 Floating store-houses (7 fertiliser, 2 sulphur). 26 Due of which 15 to load (8 metal products, 2 fertiliser, 4 coal, 1 sunflower seeds). 8 To discharge (4 general cargo, 1 metal products, 1 spars, 1 ore, 1 sunflower seeds). 3 To discharge/load general cargo. Kerch - Three vessels under repair/dry-docked, 1 due. Berdyansk - Two vessels loading at berth (1 agri-products, 1 metal products), 1 discharging rice at berth, 1 waiting orders to load agri-products. 5 Due, all to load, of which 2 metal products, 1 coal, 1 fertiliser, 1 agri-products.

Mariupol - 13 Vessels in port operating of which 10 loading (5 fertiliser, 1teel, 1 slabs, 2 coal, 1 sunflower seeds). 2 Discharging (1 alumina, 1 ore). 1 Discharging/loading containers. 7 Waiting in roads of which 6 to load (1 coal, 1 fertiliser, 4 steel), 1 to discharge mustard seed. 26 Due of which 15 to load (8 steel, 2 fertiliser, 3 coal, 2 sunflower seeds). 4 To discharge (1 coal, 1 ferrous metal, 1 flourspar, 1 bauxite). 7 To discharge/load containers.

Odessa - Nov 5 - 18 Operating of which 4 loading (1 metal, 1 urea, 1 sar, 1 fuel oil). 2 Discharging (1 bananas, 1 general cargo), 1 discharging/loading containers, 3 passenger vessels. 4 Under repairs, 3 waiting, 1 changing crew. 4 In roads of which 3 to load (1 sunflower seeds, 1 oil, 1 metal), 1 waiting. 18 Due of which 11 to load (4 metal, 2 fertiliser, 2 wheat, 1 sunflower seeds, 1 paper, 1 seedcake). 4 To discharge (2 citrus, 1 sugar, 1 bananas), 2 to discharge/load containers. Nov 5 - Odessa - Steel cargo loaders 1 berthed, 1 anchored, 3 due. Containers 1 berthed, 1 due. Grain loaders 1 anchored, 2 due. Sugar dischargers 1 due. Tankers (loading) 1 berthed, 1 anchored. General cargo 1 berthed, 4 due. Fertiliser 1 berthed, 2 due. Ferries 1 berthed. Ilychevsk - Steel cargo loaders 3 berthed. General cargo 1 berthed.

YUGOSLAVIA, Nov 5 - Bar - Three vessels berthed of which 2 discharging (1 bananas, 1 iron ore), 1 loading aluminium, 4 ferries, no delays. Zelenika (Bijela) - Three berthed, no commercial operations, 2 under repairs, no delays.
